geographic_context: Milwaukee regional meteorology; no surveyed installation is claimed
topology: Only the existing dam-pool -> gate -> wetland/river passage; no independent dam spillway
gate_type: Rectangular vertical-lift sluice gate at the upstream end of an open, horizontal rectangular sill/apron
crest_shape: Horizontal flat rectangular broad crest with square upstream edge; no ogee profile or suction is assumed
contraction_assumption: Vertical parallel training walls preserve the stated clear width; no end-contraction deduction. Entrance/friction losses are nonnegative, not energy sources.
new_dimension_origin: 1.0 m is an explicit hypothetical audit geometry, not an observation or a calibrated optimum. It gives H/L=0.05..0.375 for H=0.05..0.375 m, inside the approximate USBR broad-crest range.
very_small_head_limitation: A fixed crest length does not remain a negligible-friction broad crest as H approaches zero. No arbitrary shallow-flow law or state cutoff has been added.
Cd_units: dimensionless; these coefficients are not broad-crest Cw
weir_coefficient_source_units_US: ft^(1/2)/s, with Q in ft^3/s and b,H in ft
coefficient_applicability: USACE general broad-crest/bridge examples provide a screening envelope, not calibration of this hypothetical gate. The rounded upper value 3.1 is slightly above the exact ideal coefficient under the stricter hydrostatic assumptions and is not adopted.
upstream_energy: Existing H = dam-pool level minus sill; approach velocity head neglected; no added pressure, pump head or lower control elevation
tailwater: Eight-state: wetland level. Six-state: river level. Safety-feasible wetland limits and valid river-geometry ceiling are below both gate sills.
low_head_submergence_treatment: No unsupported correction is invented; a future variant must explicitly reject or model any low-head drowned-crest state outside its proven domain.
preserved_gate_schedules: Original saved Stage B gate knots, unchanged; no scaling, clipping or adaptive control
compatibility_result: Blocked: unchanged gate branch at H/a=1.25 exceeds same-width broad-crest ideal energy capacity; changing Cw or crest length does not fix that endpoint.
